record.question: Which state Government is to partner with Massachusettes Institute of Technology (MIT)-based Abdul LatifJameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL) for transformative action?
record.explanation: Answer C: Odisha. The Government of Odisha entered a partnership with J-PAL South Asia on 31 October 2019 for evidence-based policymaking and state anti-poverty programs. Reference: https://www.povertyactionlab.org/updates/government-odisha-partners-j-pal-south-asia-maximize-impact-anti-poverty-programs. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
